documentation.title: Available Fields
documentation.standard:
Listing commands that call format_items() should document their columns in an ## AVAILABLE FIELDS section, so users know what --fields accepts.
Requirement: C4 / G3 (SHOULD, warning). Error codes: MissingAvailableFields. Properties: ignoreMethods (method names that are never commands), ignoreClasses (classes that are never command classes).

code_comparison.code: /** * List jobs. * * ## AVAILABLE FIELDS * * * id * * status */
/** * List jobs. * * ## EXAMPLES * * wp acme job list */
